entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Func-eval ref struct result: ExternalMemoryHandle doesn't keep a collectible LoaderAllocator alive (access violation in GC after unload) #135252
  • Debugger external-memory func-eval results can expose stale cached fields after GC #135251
  • Debugger func-eval can use stale non-leaf register values after GC #135249
  • Debugger func-eval byref result can become stale before deferred completion #135247
  • Debugger func-eval: a by-value `ref struct` with overlapping `ref` fields is reported to the GC twice, so a compacting GC relocates the byref twice #135245
  • `HasSameMetadataDefinitionAs` throws `NotImplementedException` on types and members from `CustomReflectionContext` #135242
  • `GetMethods` and `GetAccessors` on a type from `CustomReflectionContext` return the base type's accessors of an added property #135240
  • SslStream on Windows stops resuming a TLS 1.3 ticket after six uses and cannot issue a replacement #135235
    Future
  • Linux x64: native memory leak for each rethrown TypeInitializationException #135234
  • [API Proposal]: Optimize memory usage of Nullable<decimal> #135232
  • Debugger func-eval cannot consume a 64-bit RAK_REGREG value-type argument #135231
  • [wasi] Library tests have no HOME/user profile (user secrets path) #135225
    12.0.0
  • DataContractSerializer roots collectible AssemblyLoadContext when serializing List<T> of a collectible type #135223
  • [browser][coreclr] Investigate five additional assemblies retained in trimmed Blazor WebAssembly publishes #135222
    12.0.0
  • Native host crash (EEStartupHelper/GCCoop, coreclr_t::create, breadcrumb_writer_t) on Windows Server 2019 with Server GC enabled, regression in 10.0.12 — minimal repro is a bare console app #135221
  • [browser][coreclr] Repeated trimmed publish drops managed assemblies when ReadyToRun is disabled #135218
    12.0.0
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: GCRefStress_AllVerificationsPass misses Windows x86 SearchValues.Create roots (CrossModule) #135217
  • Runtime-async: invalid program when awaiting generic Task upcasted to Task. #135215
    12.0.0
  • ilasm: -DET derives the MVID, PE timestamp and PDB ID from a zero-filled buffer, so different assemblies share them #135214
  • ILLink leaves zero-length LocalScope rows in the PDB when it removes dead code, sometimes out of order #135213
    12.0.0
  • ilasm: PdbChecksum hashes only the #Pdb stream, and -DET leaves the PDB ID's stamp at 0 #135211
  • [API Proposal]: BinaryPrimitives API for structs with `where T : unmanaged` #135207
  • Simplify DI-backed rotating client certificate selection in HttpClientFactory #135206
  • Improve ZIP encryption method detection #135205
    12.0.0
  • SIGSEGV in GC stack walk (MethodDesc::GetSig) with mixed interpreter/ReadyToRun execution on iOS (.NET 11 RC1) #135203
  • Backport #124725 to release/10.0: FileStream.Flush(flushToDisk: true) ignores fsync errors on Linux (silent data loss on NFS) #135201
  • [browser][coreclr] WASM0001 SkiaSharp.SkiaApi.sk_manageddrawable_set_procs' #135200
    12.0.0
  • Log non-HTTP handler exceptions in default IHttpClientFactory logging #135199
  • [Mono][LLVM][arm64] HFA struct argument passed on the stack is corrupted when caller and callee are compiled by different backends #135197
  • JIT: struct copies between overlapping fields should snapshot the source #135194
  • [API Proposal]: Debugger.Annotate(string, Exception): context an attached debugger shows at that exception's stop, without stopping the process #135193
